origin.description: Turn concordance text into offset, source file, and source lines.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A concordance string, or anything else.

origin.details: Text that does not contain a concordance line is None. The numeric run is expanded from its run-length encoding.

translation.description: Turn concordance text into offset, source file, and source lines.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A concordance string, or anything else.

translation.details: Text that does not contain a concordance line is None. The numeric run is expanded from its run-length encoding.
translation.example:
from tools.concordance import as_rconcordance
r = as_rconcordance("concordance:foo.tex:bar.Rnw:5 1 1")
print(r["offset"], r["srcFile"], ",".join(str(v) for v in r["srcLine"]))
